comment: Just-in-time membership allowlist for the platform API (BRAVO_ACCESS_MEMBERS_FILE, migration 0006). A verified Cloudflare Access email listed here gets these roles in this tenant on its first login only. Any other email is never granted (403 unknown_principal; an admin grants with python -m bravo_api.admin grant). Operator and approver are never the same person (D-18). Coordinator instruction 2026-11-02: naver = operator (requester), gmail = approver.
